summary: Skratch showcases his dungeon-farming teams for both Growth Domains and Equipment Dungeons. He highlights how the Aura team powered by Talethia (especially at Inspiration 5) completely trivializes all Equipment Dungeons (Grave of Venom, Grave of Curse, Grave of Rot) and Frost Domain stage 18. He also details his setups and stat requirements for Shadow Domain and Tempest Domain.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: At Inspiration 5 she melts bosses instantly and allows one Aura team to clear all equipment dungeons and Frost Domain.

heroes.name: Saverio
heroes.note: Destroys waves and deals massive damage in Shadow Domain, but requires survivability support to survive boss ultimate attacks.

heroes.name: Lincos
heroes.note: Does not provide enough survivability or utility for stage 18 domains; replace with an additional support hero.

teams.note: Requires high accuracy and invincibility timing to prevent the boss ultimate from one-shotting the party.
High accuracy (200+) and burst firepower are required to defeat the dragon add spawns before getting wiped.
Universal Aura team capable of fast-clearing Grave of Curse, Grave of Rot, Grave of Venom, and Frost Domain.

meta_changes: Aura teams have superseded Ice Blast as the premier early-to-mid progression team for clearing all equipment dungeons effortlessly.
tips: For high Growth Domain stages (Stage 16-18), aim for 200+ to 260+ Accuracy on debuffers to prevent constant resistance.
Run extra survivability or support heroes instead of full glass-cannon DPS when attempting Stage 18 Growth Domains.
title: USE THESE TEAMS To Farm All Bosses In Dragonheir: Silent Gods x Dragonstride
